title: Signing in, and common sign-in problems
description: How to sign in with your email address and password, and what the two error messages on the sign-in screen actually mean.
body:
Sign in with the email address and password you signed up with. If it fails, the message you get does not say which of the two is wrong.

Sign in

  1. Open Scoryboard and go to Sign in to Scoryboard.

  2. Enter your email address and password.
  3. Select Login. Scoryboard opens your home page.

Signing in with Google or Apple

Select Log in with Google and follow Google's prompts. Select Log in with Apple and follow Apple's prompts.

Use the same method you signed up with. If you signed up with Google, your account has no password, so Login will not work for you.

If it does not work

  • "The credential is invalid or has expired." This is the message for a wrong password and for an address that has no account. Scoryboard does not tell you which, on purpose. Check the address for a typo first, then reset your password.

  • "Email must be valid." What you typed is not an email address. This one is checked in your browser, before Scoryboard is asked.

  • "This user account has been disabled." Your account has been turned off. Contact support.
  • "Too many attempts. Please try again later." Too many failed sign-ins in a row. Wait, then try again.
